decisions.statement: A result past the character limit is clipped.
A clipped result says how many characters are not shown.
A tool call with no result is drawn as pending.
A tool call that failed is marked as failed.
A subagent transcript is drawn inside the call that started that transcript.
A subagent nested past the depth limit is said to be too deep.
A subagent the reader has not read is said to be unread.
A disclosure has the id of the call that disclosure draws.
